_template_note: UNSIGNED TEMPLATE — DO NOT BROADCAST. Two SEPARATE spend bundles: `lock_bundle` creates the HTLC coin, `claim_bundle` spends it AFTER the lock has been confirmed in a block. They cannot be merged: the claim branch emits ASSERT_BEFORE_SECONDS_RELATIVE (84), and relative time conditions are forbidden on an ephemeral coin (one created and spent in the same bundle) — consensus refuses the merged bundle with EPHEMERAL_RELATIVE_CONDITION. In any real cross-chain flow the lock is confirmed and observed by the counterparty long before a claim exists, so nothing is lost. All coin ids, parent ids, puzzle reveals for the maker's wallet coin, and the aggregated_signatures are placeholders. The HTLC puzzle_reveal, puzzle_hash, and solution encodings below are REAL outputs of the test vectors in run_tests.py (throwaway keys; run_tests.py checks them and `run_tests.py --write-hex` regenerates them) so the shape is verifiable locally with brun. Replace every 0x00.. placeholder before real use, sign with the wallet, and validate on testnet11 first.

lock_bundle._comment: BUNDLE 1 (lock): maker's standard coin -> HTLC coin + change, atomically (spec §5c 'Change'). puzzle_reveal/solution depend on the maker's wallet puzzle — placeholders here. Broadcast this bundle first and wait for it to be included in a block.

Requires the claimer's BLS signature over the claim message (see README.md); aggregated_signature below is a zero placeholder.
